title: 第十五章 风雨欲来求追读求月票第十六章 杀穿暗巷
slug: 从效法万妖开始成就真仙
lines: “谢过田兄。”
张仲平放下双掌，重新扫向面前的徒弟们。
黑水城看似混乱。
实际上大到一条街，小到一块砖，都是有主的。
所谓给自己半日，便是在那段时间里，无论黑白，整条青柳巷都不会有人路过。
半日过后，也不会有人在意那里发生了什么。
“他是什么实力？”
张仲平垂眸看向前方地上，目光落在赵鹏脸上的伤口上。
“应该跟徒儿差不多，强也有限。”
赵鹏沉思片刻，回忆着那狐狸出手时的力度，其实也就那样。
如果不是有捕快在场，自己放松了警惕，根本不可能吃那么大的亏。
为了补救，赵鹏立刻接了一句：“而且徒儿已经让几个师弟守住了那条街，他插翅也难逃！”
“我儿不能白死。”
张仲平长长吐出一口气来：“云海，半日够吗？”
人群中，身形瘦削的男人迈步而出。
他淡淡道：“一柱香足矣。”
随着话音落下，又是七人走出，连带着地上的赵鹏，总共八位，全都跟在了男人后头。
秦云海乃是武馆大师兄，也是武艺最接近师父的人。
对方已经熟练掌握内劲，只差些许顿悟，便可将其外放，获得大武师的名头。
“取刀吧。”
张仲平挥了挥手。
旁边弟子立马抱来一堆白布裹着的条状物走过来。
这些都是城里最好的精钢长刀。
“为师不想听他解释，也不想看他求饶。”
张仲平重新闭上眼睛，强行按捺的伤感，终于化作浓郁的寒意。
在其双掌的略微发力下，椅子扶手寸寸崩裂。
“提他的头来见我。”
日月轮转。
又至入夜时分。
大街上人来人往，热闹异常。
青柳巷本就是西城角落里，上不得台面的一条暗巷。
里面发生的事情太小，压根影响不到这座城池半分。
两个捕快照例巡着街。
其中异常年轻的黑脸捕快照例朝前方走去，却突然被旁边的老捕快扯住袖子。
“嗯？”常奕回头，疑惑朝前辈看去。
“今天不巡那条街，走这边儿。”

"Thank you, Brother Tian."
Zhang Zhongping put down his palms and glanced at the disciples in front of him again.
Blackwater appears to be in chaos.
In fact, everything as big as a street or as small as a brick has its own owner.
The so-called giving yourself half a day means that during that time, no one will pass by in the entire Qingliu Lane, no matter black or white.
After half a day, no one will care what happened there.
"What strength is he?"
Zhang Zhongping lowered his eyes and looked at the ground in front of him, his eyes falling on the wounds on Zhao Peng's face.
"It should be about the same as my disciple. There is a limit to how strong you can be."
Zhao Peng pondered for a moment, recalling the strength of the fox's attack. In fact, it was just that.
If it weren't for the presence of the police and he relaxed his vigilance, there would be no way he would have suffered such a big loss.
In order to make up for it, Zhao Peng immediately added: "Besides, my disciple has asked several junior brothers to guard that street, and he can't escape even if he has wings!"
"My son's death cannot be in vain."
Zhang Zhongping let out a long breath: "Hai Yun, is half a day enough?"
Among the crowd, a thin man stepped out.
He said calmly: "One stick of incense is enough."
As the words fell, seven more people walked out, including Zhao Peng on the ground, a total of eight people, all following the man.
Qin Yunhai is the senior martial arts master and the person closest to his master in martial arts.
The opponent has already mastered the internal energy, and is only a little short of enlightenment before he can release it and gain the title of great martial artist.
"Get the knife."
Zhang Zhongping waved his hand.
The disciple next to him immediately came over with a pile of strips wrapped in white cloth.
These are some of the best steel long knives in town.
"My master doesn't want to hear his explanation, nor do I want to see him begging for mercy."
Zhang Zhongping closed his eyes again, and the sadness he forcibly suppressed finally turned into a strong chill.
Under the slight exertion of his palms, the armrests of the chair shattered inch by inch.
"Bring his head to me."
…
The sun and moon rotate.
It's night time again.
There were people coming and going on the street, and it was extremely lively.
Qingliu Lane is originally a dark alley in the corner of the West City that cannot be accessed from the street.
What happened inside was too small to affect the city at all.
Two snapshots were taken patrolling the streets.
Among them, the unusually young black-faced police officer walked forward, but was suddenly grabbed by his sleeve by the old police officer next to him.
"Huh?" Chang Yi turned around and looked at his senior in confusion.
"I'm not patrolling that street today. I'm going this way."
